title: Bingo Was His Name-O 🐶 B-I-N-G-O Clap Along! | Tiny Tune Town Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs
intro: There was a farmer who had a dog, and Bingo was his name-o! Farmer Ollie the octopus and Bingo the puppy sing the classic B-I-N-G-O song with a brand new tune. Each verse one more letter turns into a clap. A fun spelling and rhythm sing-along for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids.
actions: Spell B-I-N-G-O out loud and point to each letter
Clap on the letters that disappear
Wag your hand like a puppy tail
Give Bingo a big hug at the end
credit: Traditional folk song, public domain (first published in 1780). New music and arrangement by Tiny Tune Town.
